svg.title: Historical UK housing data compared with the fitted simulation
svg.desc: Three time-series charts compare actual and simulated house prices, completed sales and mortgage approvals from 2015 to 2024. The simulation diverges materially in the 2024 holdout period.
svg.text: The model misses 2024 sales and approvals
Parameters were fitted to 2015–2023. The shaded 2024 period was not used during fitting.
